levels.surface: محمد بن الحسين بن متّ الجوهري

notes: The first isnad («حَدَّثَنِي عَلِيُّ بْنُ الْحُسَيْنِ ... عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ») ends at محمد بن أحمد in the text; the names after him are written only in the second isnad, so the first is not extended.
The second isnad carries the same saying (the Ziyara) and repeats محمد بن أحمد, so it is its own group with a null tail.
«وَ ذَكَرَ مِثْلَهُ» gives the same saying through a different transmitter (أبي علي الخزاعي): a variant group, not a route of this saying.
